card.title: Pixel Fingerprint Calibration
symptoms: in-display fingerprint not working after screen replacement

claims.statement: Pixel 6+ in-display fingerprint must be recalibrated after any screen swap (including donor screens) using Google's web tool at pixelrepair.withgoogle.com/udfps with the phone in Fastboot.

procedure: Power off 10 s; hold Volume Down + Power for Fastboot.
Open the UDFPS calibration page, connect, install software.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
